note: Generated from the shipped cash-flow artifacts via the same serving code as the API. Values are invoice-clearance proxies, not verified cash receipts.

model.selection: xgboost_daily achieved weekly-path WAPE 0.1219 vs best baseline seasonal_naive 0.1774 (31.3% relative improvement) and beat it on >= 4 origins.

assumptions: Weekly collection totals are the modelled forecast; daily values are derived estimates allocated by historical weekday shares.
USD and CAD are forecast independently; no FX conversion is applied.
Forecast origin is the last complete week; the horizon starts the next day.
Forecast values are nominal amounts in the invoice currency.
7.disclaimer: Target is an invoice-clearance proxy: collections are approximated by invoice amounts dated at payment_date. The dataset has no payment ledger and no amount-received column, so partially settled invoices may over- or under-state cash actually received. These figures are not bank-verified cash inflow.

proxy.target_definition: collection_proxy(date, currency) = SUM(invoice_amount) of invoices with invoice_status == 'paid' whose payment_date falls on that date, grouped by invoice_currency. Invoice-clearance proxy, not verified cash received.
